Vendored from https://github.com/raktim-mondol/papermemory
Commit: 5f39434282daa8ac5b566f5717bb414f7edf6892 (tag v0.3.1, pushed)
Version: 0.3.1 upstream; vendored as 0.3.2 (local dream/recap changes below)
Upstream exceptions:
- library_export.py: a collection's project scopes every export even when
  --out is given (a collection's project is inferred whenever it is named;
  the default .bib destination is still used only for BibTeX/BibLaTeX).
  Regression: tests/test_library_export.py::
  test_a_collections_project_scope_survives_an_explicit_out.

- dream.py (new) and `papermemory dream`: offline consolidation of observations,
  lessons and quarantined legacy claims (dry run unless --apply). Tests:
  tests/test_dream.py.
- context.py: recap selects notes half by importance (tier, lookups, confidence)
  and half by recency, hides stale/superseded notes, reports stale_notes_hidden.
- db.py / search_v2.py / audit.py: `touch_observations` counts search hits
  (best effort, no event); note search skips stale/superseded notes.
- ingest.py: re-ingesting a manuscript supersedes its previous auto-generated
  note instead of adding a copy; `manuscript_notes_text` is shared with dream.

Tests are the upstream tests (vendor/papermemory/tests, tests/test_phase0.py …
test_phase7.py), run by CI. The upstream skill is not copied; the plugin's
skills/papermemory/SKILL.md is adapted for DeepSeek Harness MCP names.

Companion local patch (this repo only): vendor/academic-harness registry
--keys aliases (entry_for consulted by resolve/resolve_all/BIB-02) and
byte-copy of .md/.txt sources, applied ahead of the Academic Harness upstream
release; documented in vendor/academic-harness/SOURCE.txt.
